messages:
olivia: Heads-up — after today's RBAC refactor deploy, members from org-alpha can see audit logs for org-beta in the Console. Repro steps below, this looks like a policy templating issue.

ajay: Can you paste the exact policy / path you hit? Did we change project_admin perms in the same deploy? @maria

olivia: Sure, snippet from the merged policy:```
- resource: "org/:org_id/audit_logs": allow role:org_owner
+ resource: "org/*/audit_logs": allow role:project_admin
```

maria: Ugh — that wildcard came from the template merge. We meant to substitute :org_id but a missing sanitize step let `*` through.

noah: Was this related to the KMS binding work? I remember a kaon PR touching role bindings and audit access.

olivia: Yes, PR #987 added a binding to let project_admins read audit logs for self-service tooling. The template function accidentally interpolated an empty var which became `*`.

sec-bot: [incident created] Severity P1 — cross-org audit visibility. Incident INC-2026-421 created and notified oncall.

ajay: Immediate mitigation: revoke the project_admin -> org/*/audit_logs binding across all orgs and rollback the policy merge. @deploy-bot can you run the revocation and start a controlled rollback?

deploy-bot: Acknowledged. Running dry-run: `rbacctl revoke-binding --role project_admin --resource "org/*/audit_logs" --dry-run`
Applying in 60s: `rbacctl revoke-binding --role project_admin --resource "org/*/audit_logs" --apply`

maria: Also recommend a KMS/crypto check — audit logs may include identifiers referencing KMS-wrapped entries. If any org-specific keys were referenced, rotate keys for affected orgs as a precaution.

olivia: I pulled a sample log — includes user email and resource ids, no plaintext secrets seen so far, but PII present. I'll open a notification to affected customers and legal.

noah: For remediation: I'll own the templating fix and add a unit test that fails on wildcard resources for org-scoped endpoints. Also adding a CI regression that scans for `org/*` usage in merged policies.

maria: I'll coordinate key rotation with CloudOps and verify KMS bindings. If we need emergency key rotation for org-beta, I'll start the runbook.

sec-bot: Actions added to INC-2026-421: revoke-binding, rollback-policy-merge, rotate-kms-keys(org-beta), ci-test(wildcard-detect), notify-customers, legal-notify.

olivia: Thanks. After rollback I'll run an ad-hoc audit to enumerate which orgs had cross-visibility and produce a timeline for the postmortem. :thumbsup:
